items.claim: Robocop possesses extreme one-punch knockout power capable of ending the fight instantly.
items.quote: He can knock out anybody for sure.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez possesses a very durable chin.
items.quote: But with Anthony Hernandez with that Mexican chin, I'm believing in that.

items.claim: Hernandez's body durability is a slight concern against taller opponents.
items.quote: The body worries me a little.

items.claim: Hernandez utilizes a high guard boxing style and blocks shots effectively.
items.quote: He has that high guard Mexican boxing style and he does block shots pretty well.

items.claim: Hernandez has the grappling ability to take the fight to the ground and finish a fatigued opponent.
items.quote: And I think he is eventually going to get this fight to where he wants it, which is the ground.

items.claim: Hernandez possesses sufficient durability and recovery cardiovascular shape to survive early heavy blows.
items.quote: I think Hernandez has the durability to come back from it and he's in the shape to recover from it.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez is currently a minus 175 betting favorite.
